{{Top|leg}}
'''Holomannequins''' were a type of [[Holoprojector/Legends|holographic projection system]] found in stores and malls. Using a holomannequin, a store could display clothing for a variety of races and species, without having to invest a huge amount in the display. Different styles would appear on the mannequin, cutting down on shoplifting.
